svg.title: Post-Mac-Setup
svg.desc: Post-Mac-Setup: Idempotent single-file Bash script that bootstraps a complete macOS development environment — Homebrew, CLI tools, GUI apps, Oh My Zsh, Powerlevel10k, and shell config from a fresh install. MIT, Shell, 33 commits. The panel lists the 23 sections mac-setup.sh runs, from Preflight Checks to Cleanup & Brewfile Export.

g.text: Idempotent single-file Bash script that bootstraps a complete
macOS development environment — Homebrew, CLI tools, GUI apps,
Oh My Zsh, Powerlevel10k, and shell config from a fresh install.
